LEGO Dumps First Seven Star Wars 50th Anniversary Sets, A New Hope 3D Poster Steals the Show
31 photos
Photo: LEGO
Although to many of us alive today it may seem unbelievable, the Star Wars universe is turning half a century old next year. That’s 50 years since A New Hope came out and completely revolutionized the science fiction genre. And as you might expect, almost everyone on this planet, from Aston Martin to LEGO, is getting ready to celebrate.
We’ll be dealing with what the Danish toy maker has up its sleeve for 2027 in this story. As one of the brands most closely linked to the Star Wars franchise, there was no way in hell LEGO would have missed the moment. In fact, its 50th anniversary party starts right on January 1, 2027, when no less than seven new sets will be released.
The toys cover pretty much everything, from artwork to vehicles, and they are inspired by some of the most iconic moments in this universe. They are all accompanied by minifigures that take after, says LEGO , the original Star Wars concept art by Ralph McQuarrie, but also by reimagined collectible Star Wars poster tiles. And here they all are in all their glory, starting with my favorite.
LEGO Star Wars A New Hope Movie Poster (75467) The first movie in the franchise is what LEGO celebrates with the A New Hope Movie Poster, a 3,209-piece set that comes together to form a poster measuring over 23 inches (59 cm) high and 16 inches (40 cm) wide. It is a plastic, 3D replica of the original theatrical poster, meaning it has a lot of things to offer.
Photo: LEGO Among them, Luke Skywalker , Princess Leia, R2-D2, and C-3PO, all four set against the backdrop of Darth Vader, the Death Star, and the Battle of Yavin. The wall art can either be mounted on a wall or leaned against something, but, sadly, it doesn’t come with a support structure of its own. It does come with a collectable alternative poster tile, though.
This set, like all the others, for that matter, will be available starting January 1, 2027 (for insiders, with the rest getting access to it three days later). The poster also happens to be the most expensive of the bunch, as it will sell for $299,99.
LEGO Star Wars Upscaled Luke Skywalker (75482)
To many the main character of the first three movies in the franchise, Luke Skywalker is celebrated in this new LEGO collection with a pretty sizeable figure, measuring over ten inches (25 cm) tall and requiring the correct assembly of 981 plastic pieces.
Luke wears for the purposes of this set his his X-wing pilot uniform and helmet, and, when fully assembled, offers moveable hands, arms, legs, and head, making it ideal for posing. And he is not alone, as his sister, Princess Leia, accompanies him in minifigure form. LEGO is willing to let them both go for $99.99.
LEGO Star Wars Rebel Y-Wing Starfighter (75478) As one of the weapons platforms of the good guys in the Star Wars universe, the Y-Wing Starfighter has always been the object of desire for collectors. LEGO brings it to life in the form of a toy standing three inches (seven cm) high, 14.5 inches (37 cm) long, and seven inches (18 cm) wide. Putting it together requires 676 plastic bricks.
Photo: LEGO The spacecraft depicted here is the one seen in the Battle of Yavin, and comes complete with the minifigures of Mon Mothma, Dutch Vander, and astromech droid R2-BHD. The set comes, for $79,99, with an exclusive Luke Skywalker minifigure.
LEGO Star Wars Darth Vader 2-In-1 Wall Art (75466) Replicated in countless shapes and sizes over the past 50 years, the main antagonist of the first three Star Wars movies is celebrated by LEGO in the form of a wall art piece. Ok, technically two of them, as builders can opt for one of two displays, measuring at most ten inches (25 cm) high and just as wide.
The first is a replica of Vader’s infamous black helmet, made from 628 plastic pieces. The second shows Vader’s “I am your father” quote, using his red lightsaber as a backdrop. Completing the $69.99 set is a Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back poster tile.
LEGO Star Wars Stormtrooper Helmet (75495) Serving the dark side while dressed in white, the fighting force of the Empire, the Stormtroopers, are celebrated by LEGO through a seven-inch (18 cm) high helmet with a design that pays tribute to the work of Ralph McQuarrie.
832 pieces of plastic are needed to form the head of the soldier with notoriously bad aim, and they are accompanied by a collectible Rogue One poster tile. The toy maker is asking $79,99 for this set, which also lands in January.
LEGO Star Wars Mustafar Duel (75470) Photo: LEGO This set brings to living rooms the moment when pre-Vader Anakin Skywalker takes on his former master and friend, Obi-Wan Kenobi. It does so with the help of two minifigures, a brick-built lava landscape, and hover pods -all of that coming to life courtesy of 372 pieces of plastic.
Accompanied by an exclusive Han Solo minifigure, this set, which stands three inches (eight cm) high and 8.5 inches (21 cm) wide, will sell right from the first day of next year for $39,99.
LEGO Star Wars Duel On Bespin (75480) Last but not least comes a set that reenacts one of the most iconic moments in Star Wars history, the fight between Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader on a bridge in Cloud City. Both characters are part of the set as minifigures, as is a printed “No, I am your father!” plaque.
The Duel on Bespin is 718 pieces strong and is accompanied by an exclusive Darth Vader minifigure, all for $79.99.
